note: One-page promotional site for Fundraiser Day. Every section is data (Testimonial, Offer, CompanyInfo rows), curated by seeding rather than public submission (create: false everywhere — this is a brochure, not a forum). The home page carries the introduction copy plus the one real widget: an auto-advancing offers carousel (plugins/fundraiser.mjs) that fetches /Offer itself and rotates on a timer. Testimonials and company information stay separate scaffold routes linked from home and the nav — the format has no single-DOM-page composition, so 'one page' is a landing page plus its linked sections, the same shape apps/obituaries and apps/poetry already use.

Testimonial.name: Maria Gonzalez
Testimonial.quote: Fundraiser Day helped us raise more in one afternoon than an entire quarter of bake sales. The energy in the room was incredible.
Testimonial.result: Raised $4,200 for the local food bank

Testimonial.name: James Whitfield
Testimonial.quote: Our youth sports league was about to cut two teams. Thanks to Fundraiser Day, every kid who wanted to play, played.
Testimonial.result: Funded 2 extra teams for the season

Testimonial.name: Priya Natarajan
Testimonial.quote: I came as a volunteer and left as a believer. Watching strangers open their wallets for a cause they'd never heard of an hour earlier says everything.

pages.title: Home
pages.heading: Fundraiser Day — Give, Celebrate, Change Lives
body: Fundraiser Day is our community's single biggest day of giving: one afternoon, dozens of local causes, and a room full of people who showed up to help. It exists for one purpose — turning an afternoon of food, music and stories into real money for the organizations that need it, from youth sports leagues to the neighborhood food bank.

Every ticket, every sponsorship and every raffle entry goes straight to the causes on stage that day. Below: what past guests said about it, what you get for showing up this year, and who is behind it all.
